new_scopes.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
new_scopes.authors: Tilmann Gneiting and Adrian E. Raftery
new_scopes.core_scope: PDF pages4-7 (printed362-365): categorical scoring definitions, Examples1-4, binary representation and Table1; continuous-score opening incidentally visible on page7. PDF page5 visually inspected.
new_scopes.incidental_scope: First1800 extracted characters of PDF pages1,2,8,14 visible during location; no case-study results adopted. Page6 includes a proof sketch, textually visible without independent proof audit.
new_scopes.mechanical_extraction: All20 pages extracted to JSON; extraction is not a full-paper read.
new_scopes.takeaway: Log/Brier proper scoring concerns probabilities and expected risk; no finite-trained-GNN calibration or ensemble quality guarantee.

new_scopes.title: Combining Predictive Distributions
new_scopes.scope: Framework prose; calibration/dispersion definitions; aggregation method definitions; Sections3.1-3.2 linear/generalized pools with theorem statements and visible proofs. No empirical-section or independent theorem/proof audit.
new_scopes.additional_metadata: Heading locator list and author/date block1; abstract page title/authors/submission metadata. HTML author block displays August24,2026; abstract metadata records2011/06/08. Exact equivalence to later published paper not audited.
new_scopes.limits: The continuous generalized-pool theorem explicitly excludes direct Bernoulli application. Its assumptions are not treated as empirically established for the current bank.
new_scopes.takeaway: Arithmetic probability and link-function pooling are distinct; combining forecasts does not guarantee calibration.
